updates.note: Reiterated plan to recruit 20,000 college graduates for the full year.

updates.note: Revenue growth guidance lowered from 1.5% - 3.5% to 1.5% - 3%.
updates.quote: we are changing our revenue growth guidance to 1.5% to 3% Y-on-Y growth in constant currency terms.

updates.note: Operating margin guidance maintained at 20% to 22%.
updates.quote: Our operating margin guidance remains the same at 20% to 22%.
